policy.identity: chain+contract/mint; EVM address-only evidence is provisional unless a unique exact chain resolves it
policy.independence: one source owner counts once even when multiple pages/APIs/Telegram surfaces repeat it
policy.persistence: prior evidence is retained in source ledgers; every scan recomputes and can upgrade an already-known asset
policy.multiplier: discovery confirmation only; never multiplies or bypasses production trade gates
policy.truth_boundary: all normal Wallet500 exact-pair, liquidity, survival, risk, holder/cluster and execution gates remain mandatory
policy.invalid_identity: EVM zero/native sentinel is never an exact token contract; generated correlation/watchlist surfaces fail closed while source ledgers remain immutable
